script.problem: Moment 2's passage Judges 9:52-56 doesn't include a verse that names Thebez in the lessons.

terra.problem: “After destroying the tower of Shechem” goes beyond Judges 9:49, which says the people in the tower were killed by fire, not that the tower was destroyed.
Joab did not tell the messenger to remind David about Abimelech. He anticipated that David might bring up Abimelech’s death and instructed the messenger to report Uriah’s death if David asked.
The moment “Joab remembers Thebez” does not take place at Thebez. It recounts a later conversation about an event that happened there.
